Any major problems/bugs to take note of? I've noticed a persistent bug across all 3 testnets of old software and/or misconfigured validators This was from a teku+besu node where besu had incorrectly told us the canonical chain was invalid. So we had no vaild blocks we could import and eventually reached a slot we were due to propose in. The besu team are looking into it to confirm that's the issue, but certainly the block proposal was on the best block the node had at the time. There were likely another couple of blocks published from that node which had long periods of empty slots before them as well based on the metrics I can see. It's back following the canonical chain again now btw. Restarted Teku and it reexecuted the block it was previously told was invalid and it imported correctly this time, so likely a race condition that caused it to be marked invalid the first time. excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: This was from a teku+besu node where besu had incorrectly told us the canonical chain was invalid. So we had no vaild blocks we could import and eventually reached a slot we were due to propose in. The besu team are looking into it to confirm that's the issue, but certainly the block proposal was on the best block the node had at the time.

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: There were likely another couple of blocks published from that node which had long periods of empty slots before them as well based on the metrics I can see.

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: It's back following the canonical chain again now btw. Restarted Teku and it reexecuted the block it was previously told was invalid and it imported correctly this time, so likely a race condition that caused it to be marked invalid the first time.
